unit:
[Unit]
Description=SOC Suricata IDS on dedicated mirror capture port
After=network.target
[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/usr/bin/suricata --pcap=capture0 --runmode=single -c /etc/suricata/suricata.yaml -S /etc/suricata/rules/soc-lab.rules -l /var/log/suricata
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
rules:
# PREPARED ONLY: benign marker, no external probing, not deployed.
alert icmp any any -> any any (msg:"SOC M4 benign ICMP marker"; content:"SOC-M4-TEST-20261101"; sid:1000001; rev:1;)
